overview: HomeoPath CRM is a professional frontend-only CRM for homeopathy clinics worldwide. It features multi-clinic management, role-based access for 6 clinic roles, a full registration and login flow, staff account creation, permission management, and dedicated dashboards per role — all with a premium glassmorphism design.
features: Professional Main Admin registration with clinic details
Email and password login for all staff accounts
Multi-clinic support — Admin sees clinic count and can switch between clinics
Staff account creation — Admin creates Doctor, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Nurse, Billing Staff accounts
Permission granting — Admin can allow staff to create new accounts
Role-based dashboards for 6 roles: Main Admin, Doctor, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Nurse, Billing Staff
Pro features gated for admin/doctor: Voice-to-text, Remedy Finder, Clinical Templates, Patient Timeline, Remedy Comparison, Case Repository, Materia Medica Browser
All data persisted in localStorage — no backend required
